description: Get item details by name or numeric ID — effect text, category, versioned purchase and sell prices, fling power, item attributes (holdable, consumable, etc.), sprite URL, and Pokémon that commonly hold it.

identifier.description: Item name in lowercase hyphenated form (e.g. "choice-specs", "leftovers") or numeric ID as a string.

name: pokeapi_get_item

cost.description: Legacy Pokédollar cost when supplied. Null when unavailable; zero is a literal amount. Independent of versioned prices.

effectText.description: Full English effect description. Null when unavailable.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: The identifier resolves to no item in PokéAPI. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

flingPower.description: Fling move base power when this item is flung. Null if not throwable.

heldByPokemon.description: Pokémon that commonly hold this item in the wild.

prices.description: All supplied price records in upstream order. Empty when no records are available.

items.description: One version and currency price record.

purchasePrice.description: Purchase price in this currency and version group. Null means not purchasable; zero is a literal amount.

sellPrice.description: Sell price in this currency and version group. Null means not sellable; zero is a literal amount.

versionGroup.description: Version group these prices apply to.

shortEffectText.description: Short English effect summary. Null when unavailable.

spriteUrl.description: Item sprite URL. Null when no sprite is available.

title: Get Item
